comment: Cross-implementation fixture for handle URL percent-encoding. Both qub_core::handle::encode_handle_for_url (Rust) and encodeHandleForUrl (TS, workers/api/src/utils/handle-url.ts) MUST produce the encoded string verbatim for the input. The contract is documented at docs/IDENTITY.md §3.2.6.9 — both sides leave the RFC 3986 unreserved set untouched (ALPHA / DIGIT / `-` / `_` / `.` / `~`) and percent-encode everything else, including non-ASCII via UTF-8 byte expansion.

cases.name: v1-ascii-simple
cases.comment: V1 ASCII handle round-trips unchanged — every existing /u/<handle> link in the wild must keep the same path bytes after V2 wiring lands.

cases.name: v1-ascii-auto-shape
cases.comment: Auto-allocated <adj>_<noun>_<digits> handle — _ is in the unreserved set so it stays unencoded.

cases.name: rfc3986-unreserved
cases.comment: Full unreserved set boundary check: A-Z a-z 0-9 - _ . ~ all stay literal.

cases.name: latin-extended
cases.comment: Latin Extended-A: ö encodes as 2-byte UTF-8.

cases.name: greek
cases.comment: Greek lowercase μαρκος. 2-byte UTF-8 per code point.

cases.name: cyrillic
cases.comment: Cyrillic марк. 2-byte UTF-8 per code point.

cases.name: arabic
cases.comment: Arabic محمد (RTL). 2-byte UTF-8 per code point. The string is logically LTR-stored; the bidi rendering belongs to the <bdi> wrapper, not the URL bytes.

cases.name: hangul
cases.comment: Hangul 마르크. 3-byte UTF-8 per syllable block.

cases.name: han-hiragana
cases.comment: Han+Hiragana mix たろう小林. UTS #39 MR exception (Japanese script combination). 3-byte UTF-8 per code point.

cases.name: supplementary-plane
cases.comment: Mathematical Double-Struck Small M (U+1D55E) — surrogate pair on the JS side, 4-byte UTF-8.

cases.name: path-reserved-ascii-slash
cases.comment: Defensive: the V2 validator rejects `/` but the encoder must escape it if seen — bug-in-upstream caller produces a 404, not a path-traversal surface.

cases.name: path-reserved-ascii-hash
cases.comment: Defensive: `#` would otherwise start a fragment.

cases.name: path-reserved-ascii-percent
cases.comment: Defensive: literal % gets escaped (otherwise a malformed encoding loop).
